Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The GDL restriction chart prints the footnote marker for the age-twenty-one exemption beside some lines in a way that does not show clearly which line it belongs to; the dossier relies only on the footnote's own wording, which names the hour, passenger and decal restrictions [A05] (verify NJ-GDL-D-FOOTNOTE).
The organ donation pages include advocacy figures about people waiting for transplants; they were left out of the fact blocks because they are not licensing rules and may change [A10].
The commercial license classes and endorsements are kept as continuation facts in part C2 because they appear in this chapter, although the Class D knowledge test centres on the basic license [A11].
Statute citations printed after each rule were summarized, not copied; fees and fines are isolated as dynamic.
